cases.title: unsigned manifest is rejected at indexing
cases.notes: The invariant is that indexing MUST fail; a registry-only API may surface a domain error code instead of SCHEMA_INVALID.

cases.title: discovery returns capability metadata without private data
cases.notes: Candidates MUST NOT carry payload fields such as data, body, or content.

cases.title: discovery returns static consent_hint, not a live policy verdict

expect.notes: A response carrying policy_verdict or missing consent_hint makes the implementation non-conforming.

cases.title: expired capability record is not indexed
cases.notes: freshness.expires_at is the only expiry judgement; expired records MUST NOT feed authorization.

cases.title: deleted native capability is invalidated within TTL
preconditions: a native capability record is indexed
steps: delete the capability at the native source (intent/function/action)

expect.notes: The record MUST stop being returned no later than TTL; both queries are recorded.

cases.title: federated record without provenance is rejected
cases.notes: provenance is required by capability-record.schema.json; the invariant is that indexing MUST fail.
